roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The user's roles that open this workspace (empty for My Workspace when no role lands there: every employee has it)

every_employee.title: Every Employee
every_employee.description: True for My Workspace (self_service): every user with an employee record has it, whatever their roles. Open it like any workspace (its window sends X-Active-Workspace: self_service), but do not count it for the launcher: a user with one role workspace opens that one directly and reaches My Workspace from the user's menu
